-- Calculate Infrastructure Quality Score for each household
-- Water Access: 'Yes' (piped) = 4, others = 1
-- Road Surface: 'Asphalt, concrete' = 4, others = 1  
-- Parking: 'Available' = 4, 'not available' = 1
SELECT 
    h.housenum,
    h.locregion,
    i.wateraccess,
    i.roadsurface,
    i.parkavail,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(i.wateraccess)) LIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END AS water_score,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(i.roadsurface)) LIKE 'asphalt%' OR LOWER(TRIM(i.roadsurface)) LIKE 'concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END AS road_score,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(i.parkavail)) LIKE 'available' AND LOWER(TRIM(i.parkavail)) NOT LIKE '%not%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END AS parking_score,
    ROUND((CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(i.wateraccess)) LIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END + 
           CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(i.roadsurface)) LIKE 'asphalt%' OR LOWER(TRIM(i.roadsurface)) LIKE 'concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END +
           CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(i.parkavail)) LIKE 'available' AND LOWER(TRIM(i.parkavail)) NOT LIKE '%not%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END)::numeric / 3, 2) AS infra_score
FROM households h
JOIN properties p ON h.housenum = p.houselink
JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink = i.infraref
LIMIT 10;
